title: EBITDA normalization proposal
description: What the first pass returns: add-back candidates, each naming a tagged line, the periods it applies to, a category from the add-back taxonomy, a one-line rationale and a confidence. No amount anywhere - the amount of a candidate is the line's figure in that period, taken from the normalized historicals and re-derived by the recompute tool before it becomes output. `needs_fact` is how a candidate says it depends on something not in the documents; it is reviewed, never assumed.

periods.description: Period labels from the historical table in which this line is an add-back. One schedule item per period.

officer_compensation.description: The line is officer or owner pay. The procedure runs the officer-compensation test against the engagement's benchmark and cites it.

needs_fact.description: A fact the add-back depends on that is not in the documents - a market rent, a settlement's terms. Stated, so a person supplies it; never assumed.
